# StudyTub

> Free, community-curated study notes for BTECH engineering students. Founded 2019.

## Pages

- [Home](https://studytub.netlify.app/): Landing page with featured courses and platform analytics
- [About](https://studytub.netlify.app/about): Our story, mission, and growth from 2019 to 4,500+ users
- [Team](https://studytub.netlify.app/team): The people behind StudyTub and how to contribute
- [FAQ](https://studytub.netlify.app/faq): Common questions about subjects, pricing, contributions, and community
- [Contact](https://studytub.netlify.app/contact): Get in touch for enquiries, contributions, or partnerships

## Markdown Twins

All pages have markdown twins served via content negotiation (AEO Spec v1.0):

- [Home](https://studytub.netlify.app/index.md)
- [About](https://studytub.netlify.app/about.md)
- [Team](https://studytub.netlify.app/team.md)
- [FAQ](https://studytub.netlify.app/faq.md)
- [Contact](https://studytub.netlify.app/contact.md)
